title: is_truncated false for base64 when max_bytes is multiple of 3
description: In decode.rs, when transfer_encoding is Base64 and max_bytes is a multiple of 3, the pre-truncation computes max_b64_chars = exactly 4*(max_bytes/3) chars, which decodes to exactly max_bytes bytes. decoded.len() == max_bytes hits the _ branch which never sets is_truncated=true for Base64/QP. Caller sees is_truncated=false even though the body was cut. Test test_base64_max_bytes_non_multiple_of_4 does not assert is_truncated, so this is untested. Trigger: any caller using is_truncated to decide whether to fetch more data, with max_bytes divisible by 3.
